description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Membership Table implementation using MySQL, specifically testing various membership table operations such as insert, read, update, and cleanup in the context of MySQL backend.

classes.name: MySqlMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans Membership Table operations with MySQL backend.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the ADO.NET invariant name for MySQL.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filter options with Trace level for the test class.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of the AdoNetClusteringTable for testing with MySQL.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance of the AdoNetGatewayListProvider for testing with MySQL.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up a database instance and retrieves the connection string for testing.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MySQL membership table (stub test).

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_GetGateways
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of gateways from the MySQL membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Verifies reading all entries from an empty membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_InsertRow
methods.description: Tests inserting a row into the membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Tests reading a row after inserting it.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Tests reading all entries after inserting multiple.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_UpdateRow
methods.description: Tests updating a membership table row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Tests concurrent updates to a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Tests updating the 'I am alive' heartbeat for a silo.

methods.name: MembershipTable_MySql_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Tests cleanup of defunct silo entries from the membership table.
